part.text:
Fixed in `py/mpz.c:6850`: comma is no longer emitted after the final digit, preventing the leading separator after reversal.

```
"{:,}".format(123_456_789_123_456_789_123_456_789)
# 123,456,789,123,456,789,123,456,789
```

All 29 `string_format*` / `int_big*` tests pass.
